_comment: Themes for search and seasonal ranking. 'words' trigger the theme from the Describe-it box. 'colors'/'finishes' define its palette (colorFamily / finish values). 'window' is [start MM-DD, end MM-DD] when the default feed leans toward it and when look discovery checks the catalog has enough looks for it (drafting starts 'leadDays' before the window). Shared by the web engine and services/discovery.

christmas.label: Christmas
christmas.brief: festive but polished: deep reds, evergreen, snowy white, gold or silver chrome accents

new-year.label: New Year's Eve
new-year.brief: party sparkle: champagne, silver or gold chrome, glittering cat-eye

valentines.label: Valentine's Day
valentines.brief: romantic: cherry or rose reds, soft pinks, tiny hearts at most

spring.label: Spring
spring.brief: fresh pastels, sheer jelly, soft French

summer.label: Summer
summer.brief: bright and glossy: juicy pinks, coral reds, ocean blues, playful mismatched

halloween.label: Halloween
halloween.brief: wearable spooky: oxblood, dark cat-eye, matte espresso, subtle details

thanksgiving.label: Thanksgiving
thanksgiving.brief: warm and cozy: chocolate, burgundy, caramel, suede-matte
